# La Bonita Brunch

> Family-owned Mexican breakfast and brunch food truck in Redmond, Oregon. Homemade breakfast burritos, burritos, tacos and flautas made with real eggs cracked to order. Order ahead for pickup online. Menu guides and stories on the blog.

## Key facts

- Type: Food truck (Mexican breakfast & brunch)
- Ownership: Family-owned, women-owned and Latino-owned
- Languages: English and Spanish (¡Hablamos español!)
- Address: 958 NW 6th St, Redmond, OR 97756, USA (just north of Brightside Thrift)
- Phone: (541) 678-4991
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 am–2:30 pm; Saturday 7:00 am–2:00 pm; Sunday closed (Pacific Time)
- Ordering: Walk up to the window, or order ahead for pickup online
- Seating: Outdoor tables and umbrellas next to the truck; pets welcome
- Any burrito can be made as a bowl (no tortilla)
- Veterans get free coffee
- Prices: See current prices on the online ordering page; prices are not listed on the website

## Menu

### Breakfast

- Ranchero Burrito: Runny eggs, beans, cheese, green salsa and sour cream.
- Breakfast Burrito: Your choice of meat, like bacon, with eggs, potato and cheese.
- Mexican Scramble: Eggs scrambled with tomato, onion and cilantro, plus beans and cheese. Burrito or bowl.
- Breakfast Asada Burrito: A breakfast burrito with carne asada.
- Nopal Burrito: Eggs, beans, cheese and grilled nopales.
- Miles Burrito: Eggs, beans and cheese.
- Chicken Breakfast
- Breakfast Tacos
- Asada Breakfast Taco: A breakfast taco with carne asada.
- Mia's Burrito

### Burritos

- Broadway Burrito: Steak, french fries, guacamole, sour cream and cheese.
- Chicken Burrito: Chicken, beans, cheese, onion, tomato, cilantro, lettuce and sour cream.
- Fish Burrito: Fish with cabbage, our special fish sauce, tomato, onion and cilantro.
- Asada Burrito: Carne asada, beans, guacamole, cheese, onion, cilantro and tomato. Try it with our green and habanero salsas.
- Shrimp Burrito: Grilled shrimp, cabbage, pico and special sauce.
- Chile Relleno Burrito: Battered roasted pepper stuffed with cheese, with beans and sour cream.
- Bean & Cheese Burrito: Beans and cheese. Simple and perfect.

### Tacos & Flautas

- Day's Tacos: Crispy fried tacos filled with mashed potato, topped with lettuce, tomato, sour cream and queso fresco.
- Las Flautas: Served in a cup over tomato broth, with lettuce, guac, sour cream, queso fresco and cheddar.
- Asada Taco: Carne asada, onion, cilantro and guacamole made fresh every day.
- Shrimp Taco: Shrimp with cabbage, tomato, onion, cilantro and our special shrimp sauce.
- Chicken Taco: Chicken, onion, cilantro and lettuce.
- Fish Taco: Fish, cabbage, pico and special sauce.
- Taco Chile Relleno: Our chile relleno, taco style.
- Bean N Cheese Taco: Beans and cheese in a taco.
- Family Flautas: A family-size order of our flautas.

### Sweets

- Churro Bites: Cinnamon sugar churros with a drizzle of cajeta, Mexican caramel.
- Carlota: A no-bake Mexican icebox cake. Cool, creamy and sweet-tart, topped with cajeta. Listed as Lemon Cookie Cream when you order.
- Cookies

### Drinks & Sides

- Café de Olla: Mexican spiced coffee. Free for veterans.
- Mexican Coca-Cola: Made with cane sugar, in the glass bottle.
- Jarritos: Ice cold, in the glass bottle.
- Red Bull: Ice cold.
- Sprite
- Ice Tea
- Juice
- Water
- Guacamole: Made fresh every day.
- Green Salsa: Our house green salsa.
- Habanero Salsa: Our house habanero salsa.
- Crema: Side of sour cream.
- Beans: Side of beans.
- Fries: Side of fries.

## FAQ

**Where is La Bonita Brunch?**
We're a food truck at 958 NW 6th St in Redmond, Oregon, just north of Brightside Thrift.

**What are your hours?**
We're open Monday through Friday from 7:00 am to 2:30 pm and Saturday from 7:00 am to 2:00 pm. We're closed on Sunday.

**What kind of food do you serve?**
We serve homemade Mexican breakfast and brunch: breakfast burritos, burritos, tacos, flautas, churro bites and carlota.

**Can I order online?**
Yes. You can order ahead for pickup through our Clover online ordering page.

**Can I get my burrito as a bowl?**
Yes. Any burrito can be made as a bowl with no tortilla.

**Do you have meatless options?**
Yes. The Ranchero, Nopal, Miles and Bean & Cheese burritos, the Mexican Scramble and Day's Tacos have no meat.

**Do you offer anything for veterans?**
Yes. Coffee is free for veterans. Just let us know at the window.

**Is there seating?**
Yes. We have tables and umbrellas next to the truck where you can eat or wait for your order.

**Are your eggs fresh?**
Yes. We crack real eggs for every order. We never use powdered or pre-packaged eggs.
